dict.string: Mycel finds people running Mycel nearby, on the same Wi-Fi or directly over peer-to-peer Wi-Fi, and sends them your encrypted messages directly, with no internet or server.
Mycel uses the microphone only during voice calls you place or answer. Your voice goes end-to-end encrypted, directly to the person you're talking to.
Mycel uses the camera only during video calls, when you turn it on, or to take a photo you choose to send. It goes end-to-end encrypted, directly to the person you're talking to.
Mycel uses Bluetooth to reach nearby phones and computers running Mycel when there is no Wi-Fi, and sends them your end-to-end encrypted messages directly.
Mycel reads the photos and videos you choose to send.
